package.name: qore-pdf-module
package.title: Qore PDF documents and rendering
package.description: Pinned PDF module with required PDFium rendering, private PoDoFo, compiled provider, translations and separate documentation/debug artifacts. Local x86_64 builds and installed runtime/SDK qualification pass on Fedora, AlmaLinux and openSUSE. Native builds are enabled for x86_64 and aarch64; installed qualification remains in progress and publication is disabled.
